content:
🗣️ BUILT CoLAB is organising a UBI Session in Milan, an international validation workshop as part of the UTS – Universal Timber Slab project.

📅 21 September 2026 🕝 2.30 pm – 5.30 pm

This event will bring together professionals from the construction ecosystem in Milan — architects, engineers, builders, property developers, timber manufacturers, public authorities, urban planners, industry associations, LCA and sustainability experts, and AEC research institutions — to test, scrutinise and contribute to the development of the UTS system – timber floor slabs for multi-storey buildings, the project’s main objective.

Programme: . Presentation of the UTS project . Strategic dialogue on market positioning and implementation potential . Networking coffee break . Practical demonstration of the UTS-BIM decision-making tools

👉 In-person event in Milan. Inscrições aqui. ✉️ Contact: uts@builtcolab.pt

UTS is a Horizon Europe (EIC Pathfinder) initiative led by the University of Stuttgart, in which BUILT CoLAB is participating, and aims to develop a new structural system based on timber floor slabs as an alternative to conventional concrete, integrating computational design, engineering, acoustics and building physics, life-cycle and cost analysis, and AI- and BIM-based tools. Information about the project can be found aqui.
